label: Bible Study
prompt: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a _____?
verse: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
note: Paul's chain of questions — no preacher, no hearing; no hearing, no believing.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for _____:
verse: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy:
note: As the new Temple's foundation was laid, old men wept while others shouted for joy — all one sound.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal _____ upon her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.
verse: And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown upon her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.
note: The king set the royal crown on Esther's head — an orphan girl, now queen of Persia.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a _____ mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
verse: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
note: David's charge to Solomon: serve God wholeheartedly, because he searches every heart and motive.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the _____ waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
verse: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
note: The 'husbandman' is a farmer, not a spouse — and he waits patiently for the early and latter rain.
